title: Number Of Corner Rectangles
goal: Count axis-aligned rectangles whose four corners are ones.
strategy: Every rectangle is determined by two rows sharing two one-columns. While processing a row, each pair of one-columns forms one rectangle with every earlier row containing that same pair.

A full three-by-four grid combines all row and column pairs
